items.raw_excerpt: 5 月 6 日，国际市场调研机构沙利文（Frost & Sullivan）发布《中国高校科研机构AI4S市场追踪报告，2025年》。报告显示，阿里云以26%的市场份额领跑中国高校科研机构AI4S云市场，稳居第一。 AI4S，即AI for Science，人工智能驱动的科学研究，被称作实验、理论、计算、数据范式之后的“第五范式”。报告显示，中国高校科研AI4S 云市场正处于快速成长期，预计2030年将达107亿元。 沙利文指出，与通用企业级AI市场相比，中国高校科研机构 AI4S 的需求正在从单一算力资源，升级为AI 全栈能力建设，更强调科研任务适配性、复杂算力与工具链协同能力，以及跨学科场景下的持续服务能力。阿里云已在“算力—平台—模型—应用—生态”全链路形成完整技术栈，成为唯一取得全栈领先的厂商。 在云基础设施层面，阿里云能够兼容各种主流架构的芯片，实现智算、超算、普算等算力全面融合，部署形态灵活，满足科研、教学等不同场景的算力需求。 在AI 平台层面，阿里云打造了端到端的全链路工程能力，依托 PAI 与百炼，提供从数据处理、模型微调、训练加速到推理部署的一站式服务，高效支撑科研探索与跨学科创新。 在模型层面，千问大模型作为全球最受欢迎的开源大模型之一，在中国一线科研人员中的使用渗透率高达85%，成为科研场景中应用最广泛、认可度最高的大模型。 特别值得一提的是，在芯片层面，阿里也在全面加速。截止今年2月，平头哥真武芯片已经累计规模化交付47万片，60%以上被外部客户采用，包括中科院等顶尖科研机构。大规模商用落地充分验证了真武芯片在真实复杂业务场景中优异的适应性和稳定性。 目前，阿里云已经服务了中国超过80%的211院校和科研机构。未来，阿里云将持续加大投入，以全球领先的全栈人工智能服务，推动中国高校科研AI4S领域的核心突破和成果落地。  雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: On May 7, Infinigence announced that it had secured over 700 million yuan in additional financing, maintaining its position as the top-funded AI-native infrastructure company in China. The co-lead investors are Hangzhou Gaoxin Financial Investment Group and Huiyuan Capital, with follow-on investors including Guoxing Capital, Chindata Group, GF Qianhe, Leaguer Qingtong, CIB Investment, AEF NextGen, Tengrui Capital, Colorlight, CSC Capital, and Will. Existing shareholders Junlian Capital, Shanghai Guotou Futing, and Yuanzhi Future also made additional investments. It is reported that this funding round was completed several months ago, with proceeds primarily allocated to three areas: first, strengthening Infinigence's leadership in diverse heterogeneous technologies and expanding the scale of optimally available computing power in the token economy era; second, enhancing its software-hardware synergy to accelerate the leap in production efficiency from "electricity to tokens"; and third, building an AI infrastructure with autonomous evolution capabilities, leveraging an enterprise-level intelligent agent service platform to provide solutions for various industry scenarios and improve value conversion from "tokens to productivity." This financing round underscores investors' deep recognition of the core value of AGI infrastructure in the token economy era. As the global industry transitions from a "model competition" to "AI productivity," Infinigence has officially released its AI productivity formula, proposing that "AI productivity = intelligence scale × token production efficiency × token."
excerpt_i18n.es: El 7 de mayo, InfiniteSilicon anunció que había obtenido más de 700 millones de yuanes en financiación adicional, manteniéndose como la empresa de infraestructura nativa de IA en China con mayor escala de financiación. Los inversores principales conjuntos fueron Hangzhou High-Tech Financial Investment Group y Huiyuan Capital, mientras que los inversores secundarios incluyeron a Guoxing Capital, Qinhuai Data, GF Qianhe, Lihe Qingtong, Zhongbao Investment, AEF NextGen, Tengrui Capital, Calait, CSC Financial Capital y Will. Los inversores anteriores Junlian Capital, Shanghai Guotou Futeng y Yuanzhi Future realizaron inversiones adicionales. Se informa que esta ronda de financiación se completó hace varios meses, y los fondos se destinarán principalmente a tres áreas: primero, consolidar la plataforma múltiple de InfiniteSilicon.
